scripts.features:
Engine & Power
Torque Slider: Cranks up your raw pulling power. You can set it way past the stock limits to hit top speeds instantly.
RPM Redline Logic: Change when the car shifts or hits the rev limiter. Setting this higher lets you stay in the power band way longer.
Idle RPM: Change how the engine idles—good for keeping the turbo spooled or just for show.
Max Boost: Overrides the turbo/supercharger PSI. You can force it to 50+ PSI for insane acceleration.
Handling & Physics
God Brakes: Custom brake force that can stop you dead even at 300MPH.
Steer Speed & Torque: Make your steering instant or heavy. High torque ensures the wheels actually turn at high speeds where games usually restrict you.
Electronic Aids: Hard-force TCS (Traction Control) and ABS (Anti-lock Braking) on or off, regardless of what the car normally allows.
Suspension & Chassis
Weight Mod: This is the big one. You can make the car weigh 500kg for fly-away speed or 5000kg so you’re a literal tank that nobody can ram off the road.
Stance Settings: Custom suspension height and stiffness. You can slam the car to the ground or lift it, and toggle if the springs are visible.
Automation & Quality of Life
Force Loop: Most games try to reset your stats every second. This loop forces your custom tune back on every millisecond so the game can’t nerf you.
Auto-Tune: As soon as you hop in any seat, the script immediately injects your custom tune so you don't have to click "Apply" every time.
Drive Refresh: If your car glitches or the engine "dies," this button restarts the internal scripts without you having to delete and respawn the car.
Ctrl+Click TP: Hold Ctrl and click anywhere on the map to instantly teleport yourself and your car to that spot.
System & Key Logic
Live Key System: No more manual updates. It pulls the valid key directly from Pastebin, so if the key changes, it updates for you automatically.
Dual Link Options: You can get your key via Linkvertise or Work.ink, whichever is faster for you.
Config Saving: All your sliders and toggles save to a file so you don't have to redo your tune every time you join.
